name: CDK Source Connector Compatibility Test

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  push:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  detect-changed-connectors:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      connectors: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.changes }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            source:
              - 'source-*'
              - 'sources/**'
              - 'connectors/source-*'
              - 'connectors/sources/**'
            destination:
              - 'destination-*'
              - 'destinations/**'
              - 'connectors/destination-*'
              - 'connectors/destinations/**'
            base:
              - 'airbyte-cdk/python/**'
              - 'airbyte-cdk/java/**'
              - 'airbyte-cdk/ruby/**'
              - 'airbyte-cdk/go/**'
              - 'airbyte-cdk/node/**'
              - 'airbyte-cdk/rust/**'
              - 'airbyte-cdk/**'
              - 'connectors/base/**'
              - 'connectors/base-python/**'
              - 'connectors/base-java/**'
              - 'connectors/base-ruby/**'
              - 'connectors/base-go/**'
              - 'connectors/base-node/**'
              - 'connectors/base-rust/**'
              - 'connectors/base-**'
              - 'toolkits/source-toolkit/**'
              - 'toolkits/destination-toolkit/**'
              - 'toolkits/extract-toolkit/**'
              - 'toolkits/load-toolkit/**'

  run-compatibility-tests:
    needs: detect-changed-connectors
    if: ${{ needs.detect-changed-connectors.outputs.connectors != '[]' && needs.detect-changed-connectors.outputs.connectors != '' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        connector: ${{ fromJson(needs.detect-changed-connectors.outputs.connectors) }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
      - name: Run compatibility test for ${{ matrix.connector }}
        run: |
          # Run the specific connector compatibility test
          python -m pytest tests/integration_tests/test_connector_compatibility.py -k "${{ matrix.connector }}" --tb=short -v
      - name: Upload test results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: test-results-${{ matrix.connector }}
          path: test-results-${{ matrix.connector }}.xml
      - name: Upload coverage data
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: coverage-data-${{ matrix.connector }}
          path: coverage.xml

  upload-test-results:
    needs: run-compatibility-tests
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          pattern: test-results-*
          merge-multiple: true
      - name: Upload test results to Codecov
        uses: getsentry/codecov-action@fda17cfc37e16a0cc23f61685813390bfee7daf3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: ./test-results-*.xml
          flags: integration-tests
          name: integration-test-results
